properties.name: BS0011
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: The site incorporates a grade II listed building, is in Flood Zone 3 and carries a potential for contamination due to its historical use as a mill. However the development of the site gives an opportunity to bring a listed building back into use. Part now in use for commercial use. Site allocated as housing site HOU119 in the adopted Local Plan (2018).
